newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Teco Energy target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Teco Energy target raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securites Inc said it raised its six-month price target for TECO Energy Inc by $5 to $30 a share.
-- EVEREN cited an agreement concerning the prudence and rate-making treatment of a new generating plant that will become commercial next month.

-- On September 25, Tampa Electric, a TECO unit, said it reached an agreement resolving all pending regulatory issues associated with its Polk Power Station. The agreement provides for full recovery of all the expected capital costs and operation and maintenance expenses associated with the power station.
-- EVEREN said its estimates remain for earnings of $1.70 a share for 1996 and $1.75 for 1997, and 5.5 percent sustainable dividend growth.
